    48	#   present, hash matches            -> ok
    49	#   present, hash differs            -> Tampered (fail)
    50	#   absent, submodule mount detected (.loa/.claude is a directory) and the
    51	#     path exists under .loa/<path>   -> not-mounted (counted, one summary
    52	#     line, informational: never changes the exit code; the mount links a
    53	#     subset of the upstream tree by design)
    54	#   absent otherwise                 -> Missing (fail)
    55	# The manifest is read once (path<TAB>hash) instead of one jq call per path.
    56	check_integrity() {
    57	  echo "Checking System Zone integrity (sha256)..."
    58	  [[ -f "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" ]] || { warn "No checksums file - skipping integrity check"; return; }
    59	
    60	  local drift=false
    61	  local submodule_mount=false
    62	  local not_mounted=0
    63	  local file expected actual
    64	  [[ -d ".loa/.claude" ]] && submodule_mount=true
    65	
    66	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r file expected; do
    67	    [[ -z "$file" || -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue

    69	    if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    70	      actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    71	      if [[ "$expected" != "$actual" ]]; then
    72	        fail "Tampered: $file"
    73	        drift=true
    74	      fi
    75	    elif [[ "$submodule_mount" == "true" && -f ".loa/${file}" ]]; then
    76	      not_mounted=$((not_mounted + 1))
    77	    else
    78	      fail "Missing: $file"
    79	      drift=true
    80	    fi
    81	  done < <(jq -r '.files | to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value)"' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
    82	
    83	  if [[ $not_mounted -gt 0 ]]; then
    84	    log "not-mounted: ${not_mounted} path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"

    86	  [[ "$drift" == "false" ]] && log "Integrity verified"

    88	}

   104	  [[ "$relative" != /* ]] || return 1

    15	# manifest itself (`.claude/checksums.json`), hashes each with
    16	# `sha256_portable` (.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh) and writes

    37	#   -h, --help   this text

    40	#   0  generated, or --check: the `files` maps are identical

    42	#      removed / changed, on stderr) or the manifest is absent / not JSON

     4	#
     5	# Writes the System Zone integrity manifest `.claude/checksums.json` from the
     6	# TRACKED `.claude/` tree only. The legacy generators (mount-loa.sh and
     7	# update.sh `generate_checksums`) walk the working tree with `find`, so build,
     8	# cache and runtime artefacts (`__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `node_modules`,

    11	#
    12	#   git -C ROOT ls-files -z -- .claude
    13	#
    14	# minus every path under `.claude/overrides/` (user-owned) and minus the
    15	# manifest itself (`.claude/checksums.json`), hashes each with
    16	# `sha256_portable` (.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh) and writes
    17	#
    18	#   {"generated": "<UTC ISO-8601>", "algorithm": "sha256",
    19	#    "files": {"<path>": "<sha256 hex>", ...}}
    20	#
    21	# pretty-printed by jq (2-space), keys in `LC_ALL=C` byte order. Two runs on
    22	# the same tree are byte-identical except `generated`. The working-tree content
    23	# of each tracked path is hashed (an unstaged edit is reflected); a tracked
    24	# path deleted from the working tree is skipped with a warning on stderr.
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh [--root DIR] [--out FILE]   # (re)generate
    28	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh --check [--root DIR] [--out FILE]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --root DIR   repository work tree to read (default: the git top level of
    32	#                the current directory)
    33	#   --out FILE   manifest path (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json). With
    34	#                --check this is the committed manifest that is compared.
    35	#   --check      regenerate to a temp file and compare its `files` map with
    36	#                the manifest at --out; nothing is written
    37	#   -h, --help   this text
    38	#
    39	# Exit codes:
    40	#   0  generated, or --check: the `files` maps are identical
    41	#   1  --check: drift (the first ten differing paths, each labelled added /
    42	#      removed / changed, on stderr) or the manifest is absent / not JSON
    43	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or a tracked path name that
    44	#      cannot be represented safely (newline, tab or backslash)
    45	# =============================================================================
    46	set -euo pipefail
    47	export LC_ALL=C
    48	
    49	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    50	# shellcheck source=../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
    51	source "${SELF_DIR}/../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    52	
    53	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    54	die2() { echo "gen-checksums: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    55	
    56	MANIFEST_REL=".claude/checksums.json"
    57	ROOT=""
    58	OUT=""
    59	CHECK=0
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --check) CHECK=1; shift ;;
    63	    --root)
    64	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    65	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --out)
    67	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--out requires a file path"
    68	      OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    69	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    70	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    71	  esac
    72	done
    73	
    74	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    75	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    76	fi

    80	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"

    82	
    83	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gen-checksums.XXXXXX")"

    87	# --- 1. the tracked set (NUL-safe, C-sorted, overrides and manifest removed) --

    90	  case "$path" in
    91	    .claude/overrides/*|"$MANIFEST_REL") continue ;;
    92	  esac
    93	  case "$path" in
    94	    *$'\n'*|*$'\t'*|*\\*) die2 "refusing a tracked path with a newline, tab or backslash: $(printf '%q' "$path")" ;;

    96	  if [[ ! -f "${ROOT}/${path}" ]]; then

    98	    echo "gen-checksums: warning: tracked path not a file in the working tree, skipped: $path" >&2
    99	    continue
   100	  fi
   101	  files+=("$path")
   102	done < <(git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -z -- .claude | sort -z)
   103	
   104	# --- 2. hash in chunks (one sha256 process per 400 paths, order preserved) ----
   105	TSV="${TMP_DIR}/files.tsv"
   106	: > "$TSV"
   107	n=${#files[@]}
   108	i=0
   109	while [[ $i -lt $n ]]; do
   110	  chunk=("${files[@]:i:400}")
   111	  hashes=()
   112	  while IFS= read -r line; do
   113	    hashes+=("${line%% *}")
   114	  done < <(cd "$ROOT" && sha256_portable "${chunk[@]}")
   115	  [[ ${#hashes[@]} -eq ${#chunk[@]} ]] || die2 "sha256 returned ${#hashes[@]} digests for ${#chunk[@]} paths"
   116	  j=0
   117	  while [[ $j -lt ${#chunk[@]} ]]; do
   118	    [[ "${hashes[j]}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die2 "unexpected sha256 output for ${chunk[j]}"
   119	    printf '%s\t%s\n' "${chunk[j]}" "${hashes[j]}" >> "$TSV"
   120	    j=$((j + 1))
   121	  done
   122	  i=$((i + 400))
   123	done
   124	[[ $n -gt 0 ]] || echo "gen-checksums: warning: no tracked files under .claude in $ROOT" >&2

   126	GEN="${TMP_DIR}/checksums.json"

   128	  {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
   129	   files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | split("\t") | {key: .[0], value: .[1]}] | from_entries)}
   130	' < "$TSV" > "$GEN"

   132	# --- 3a. write ----------------------------------------------------------------
   133	if [[ $CHECK -eq 0 ]]; then
   134	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
   135	  chmod 0644 "$GEN"

   137	  mv -f "$GEN" "$OUT"
   138	  echo "gen-checksums: wrote $n entries to $OUT" >&2
   139	  exit 0
   140	fi
   141	
   142	# --- 3b. --check --------------------------------------------------------------
   143	if [[ ! -f "$OUT" ]]; then
   144	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest not found: $OUT (run tools/gen-checksums.sh)" >&2
   145	  exit 1
   146	fi
   147	if ! jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$OUT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

   149	  exit 1
   150	fi
   151	DIFF="${TMP_DIR}/diff.txt"
   152	jq -rn --slurpfile old "$OUT" --slurpfile new "$GEN" '
   153	  ($old[0].files) as $o | ($new[0].files) as $n |
   154	  ( [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select($o | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "added"} ]
   155	  + [ $o | keys[] | . as $p | select($n | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "removed"} ]
   156	  + [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select(($o | has($p)) and $o[$p] != $n[$p]) | {p: $p, k: "changed"} ] )
   157	  | sort_by(.p) | .[] | "\(.k): \(.p)"
   158	' > "$DIFF"
   159	count=$(wc -l < "$DIFF" | tr -d ' ')
   160	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
   161	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: OK ($n entries match $OUT)" >&2
   162	  exit 0
   163	fi
   164	echo "gen-checksums: --check: DRIFT — $count path(s) differ between $OUT and the tracked tree:" >&2

   167	echo "gen-checksums: regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   168	exit 1

   172	#
   173	# CI gate for the System Zone integrity manifest: every path listed in

   177	# mount has, so every downstream `check-loa.sh` reports them as Missing.

   180	#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
   181	#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
   182	#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
   183	#                      (a path component of that name)
   184	#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
   185	#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
   186	#                  other
   187	#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
   188	# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
   189	# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
   190	#
   191	# Last line on stdout:
   192	#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
   193	#
   194	# Usage:
   195	#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
   196	#
   197	# Options:
   198	#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
   199	#                    current directory)
   200	#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
   201	#   -h, --help       this text
   202	#
   203	# Exit codes:
   204	#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
   205	#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
   206	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
   207	#      not JSON with a `files` object
   208	# =============================================================================
   209	set -euo pipefail
   210	export LC_ALL=C
   211	
   212	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
   213	die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
   214	
   215	ROOT=""
   216	MANIFEST=""
   217	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   218	  case "$1" in
   219	    --root)
   220	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
   221	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   222	    --manifest)
   223	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
   224	      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   225	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
   226	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
   227	  esac
   228	done
   229	
   230	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
   231	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
   232	fi
   233	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
   234	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
   235	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
   236	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
   237	[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
   238	[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
   239	jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   240	  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"
   241	
   242	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
   243	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
   244	trap cleanup EXIT
   245	
   246	# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
   247	# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
   248	git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
   249	jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
   250	comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   251	comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"
   252	
   253	classify() {
   254	  local p="$1"
   255	  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
   256	    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"

   258	    printf '.pyc'
   259	  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
   260	    printf '.lock'
   261	  else
   262	    printf 'other'
   263	  fi
   264	}

   266	# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"

   270	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   271	done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   272	
   273	: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   274	while IFS= read -r p; do
   275	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   276	  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   277	done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"

   279	entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
   280	n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
   281	n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')
   282	
   283	class_summary=""

   285	  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2

   287	    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   288	    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
   289	    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
   290	    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
   291	    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
   292	  done
   293	fi
   294	if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   295	  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
   296	  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
   297	fi
   298	
   299	echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"

   301	  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   302	  exit 1
   303	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;

   187	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host

   199	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead

   206	# =============================================================================

   198	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
   199	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
   200	#
   201	# Exit codes:
   202	#   0  printed
   203	#   2  usage error
   204	#
   205	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
   206	# =============================================================================
   207	set -euo pipefail
   208	export LC_ALL=C
   209	
   210	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
   211	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
   212	
   213	SOURCE_TREE=""
   214	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
   215	BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"
   216	JSON=false
   217	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   218	  case "$1" in
   219	    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="${2:?--source-tree needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   220	    --claude-bin)  CLAUDE_BIN="${2:?--claude-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   221	    --bats-bin)    BATS_BIN="${2:?--bats-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
   222	    --json)        JSON=true; shift ;;
   223	    -h|--help)     sed -n '2,28p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
   224	    *) echo "fingerprint.sh: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
   225	  esac
   226	done
   227	if [[ -z "$BATS_BIN" ]]; then
   228	  if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then BATS_BIN=bats
   229	  else BATS_BIN="$HOME/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats"; fi
   230	fi
   231	
   232	# first line of `<bin> <args>`, whitespace collapsed; `absent` when not runnable
   233	tool_version() {  # tool_version <bin> <args...>
   234	  local bin="$1"; shift
   235	  if ! command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ ! -x "$bin" ]]; then printf 'absent'; return 0; fi
   236	  local out
   237	  out="$("$bin" "$@" 2>&1 < /dev/null || true)"
   238	  out="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '1p' | tr -s ' \t' ' ' | sed 's/^ //; s/ $//')"
   239	  [[ -n "$out" ]] || out="unknown"
   240	  printf '%s' "$out"
   241	}
   242	
   243	lines="$(
   244	  {
   245	    printf 'claude=%s\n'  "$(tool_version "$CLAUDE_BIN" --version)"
   246	    printf 'codex=%s\n'   "$(tool_version codex --version)"
   247	    printf 'python3=%s\n' "$(tool_version python3 --version)"
   248	    printf 'node=%s\n'    "$(tool_version node --version)"
   249	    printf 'yq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version yq --version)"
   250	    printf 'jq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version jq --version)"
   251	    printf 'bats=%s\n'    "$(tool_version "$BATS_BIN" --version)"
   252	    printf 'git=%s\n'     "$(tool_version git --version)"
   253	    printf 'docker=%s\n'  "$(tool_version docker --version)"
   254	  } | LC_ALL=C sort
   255	)"
   256	src="none"
   257	if [[ -n "$SOURCE_TREE" ]]; then
   258	  src="$(git -C "$SOURCE_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
   259	fi
   260	lines="$lines"$'\n'"source_tree=$src"
   261	digest="$(printf '%s\n' "$lines" | python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).hexdigest())')"
   262	fp="fp:$digest"
   263	
   264	if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   265	  printf '%s\n' "$lines" | jq -Rn --arg fp "$fp" --arg src "$src" '
   266	    [inputs | select(length > 0)] as $l
   267	    | {fingerprint: $fp, source_tree: $src, lines: $l,
   268	       tools: ($l | map(select(startswith("source_tree=") | not) | capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$") | {(.k): .v}) | add)}'
   269	else
   270	  printf '%s\n' "$fp"
   271	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# freeze.sh — cycle-130 ablation suite freeze (SDD §5.13, DEC-0404, DEC-0414)
     4	#
     5	# Writes or verifies <root>/MANIFEST.sha256, the suite's frozen identity: one
     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
     7	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
     8	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).
     9	# validate-suite.sh runs first; an invalid suite is never frozen or accepted.
    10	#
    11	# Usage:
    12	#   freeze.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--check] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
    13	#
    14	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
    16	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
    19	#
    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
    23	#
    24	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
    26	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
    27	# =============================================================================
    28	set -euo pipefail
    29	export LC_ALL=C
    30	
    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
    36	VARGS=()
    37	
    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    40	
    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    42	  case "$1" in
    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
    55	
    56	vrc=0
    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
    58	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
    60	
    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
    62	compute_manifest() {
    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
    66	  local d
    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
    73	import hashlib, os, sys
    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
    76	    if not rel:
    77	        continue
    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:

   125	#!/usr/bin/env bash
   126	# =============================================================================
   127	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
   128	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
   129	#
   130	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
   131	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
   132	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
   133	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
   134	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
   135	#
   136	# Rules:
   137	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
   138	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
   139	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
   140	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
   141	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
   142	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
   143	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
   144	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
   145	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
   146	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
   147	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
   148	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
   149	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
   150	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
   151	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
   152	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
   153	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
   154	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
   155	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
   156	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
   157	#                              are not frontmatter)
   158	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
   159	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
   160	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
   161	#                              "no mount"
   162	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
   163	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
   164	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
   165	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
   166	#
   167	# Usage:
   168	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
   169	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
   170	#
   171	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
   172	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
   173	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
   174	#
   175	# Exit codes:
   176	#   0  every rule OK
   177	#   1  any rule FAIL
   178	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
   179	#
   180	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
   181	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
   182	# =============================================================================
   183	set -euo pipefail

   222	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt

   225	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   226	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3

   357	rule_integrity_clean() {
   358	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   359	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   360	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   361	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   362	  fi
   363	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   364	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   365	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   366	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   367	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   368	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   369	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   370	def sha(p):
   371	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   372	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   373	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   374	            h.update(b)
   375	    return h.hexdigest()
   376	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   377	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   378	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   379	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   380	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   381	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   382	    elif sha(p) != want:
   383	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   384	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   385	  local n bad missing filesha first
   386	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   387	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   388	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   389	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   390	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   391	  return 0
   392	}
   393	rule_applicability_refused() {

   399	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \

   402	    fi
   403	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   404	  fi
   405	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   406	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   407	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   408	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \

   411	  fi

   415	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   416	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   417	  R="$1"

   419	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   420	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   421	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   422	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   423	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   424	  ARM="$arm"
   425	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   426	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   427	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   428	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   429	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   430	    return 0
   431	  fi
   432	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   433	    rules="applicability_refused"
   434	  else
   435	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   436	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   437	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   438	  fi
   439	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   440	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   441	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   442	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   443	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   444	    else
   445	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   446	    fi
   447	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   448	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   449	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   450	    else
   451	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   452	    fi
   453	  done <<<"$rules"
   454	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   455	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   456	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   457	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   458	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   459	  else
   460	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   461	  fi
   462	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   463	}
   464	
   465	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   466	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   467	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   468	  exit "$rc"
   469	fi
   470	
   471	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
   472	runs=0 failed=0
   473	while IFS= read -r d; do
   474	  runs=$((runs + 1))
   475	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
   476	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   477	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   478	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
   479	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
   480	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
   481	[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
   482	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
   483	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# freeze.sh — cycle-130 ablation suite freeze (SDD §5.13, DEC-0404, DEC-0414)
     4	#
     5	# Writes or verifies <root>/MANIFEST.sha256, the suite's frozen identity: one
     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
     7	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
     8	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).
     9	# validate-suite.sh runs first; an invalid suite is never frozen or accepted.
    10	#
    11	# Usage:
    12	#   freeze.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--check] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
    13	#
    14	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
    16	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
    19	#
    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
    23	#
    24	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
    26	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
    27	# =============================================================================
    28	set -euo pipefail
    29	export LC_ALL=C
    30	
    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
    36	VARGS=()
    37	
    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    40	
    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    42	  case "$1" in
    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
    55	
    56	vrc=0
    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
    58	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
    60	
    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
    62	compute_manifest() {
    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
    66	  local d
    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
    73	import hashlib, os, sys
    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
    76	    if not rel:
    77	        continue
    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
    80	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
    81	            h.update(b)
    82	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
    83	PY
    84	  rm -f "$list"
    85	}
    86	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
    87	
    88	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
    89	trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
    90	compute_manifest "$TMP"
    91	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
    92	
    93	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
    94	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
    95	  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
    96	    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
    97	    exit 0
    98	  fi
    99	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"
   100	  python3 -I - "$MANIFEST" "$TMP" <<'PY'
   101	import sys
   102	def load(p):
   103	    m = {}
   104	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
   105	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
   106	        if line:
   107	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
   108	            m[rel] = h
   109	    return m
   110	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
   111	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
   112	    if rel not in new:
   113	        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
   114	    elif rel not in old:
   115	        print(f"  added    {rel}")
   116	    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
   117	        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
   118	PY
   119	  exit 1
   120	fi
   121	
   122	cp "$TMP" "$MANIFEST.tmp" && mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
   123	echo "freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 ($n files, sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
   124	exit 0
   125	#!/usr/bin/env bash
   126	# =============================================================================
   127	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
   128	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
   129	#
   130	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
   131	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
   132	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
   133	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
   134	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
   135	#
   136	# Rules:
   137	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
   138	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
   139	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
   140	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
   141	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
   142	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
   143	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
   144	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
   145	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
   146	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
   147	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
   148	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
   149	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
   150	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
   151	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
   152	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
   153	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
   154	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
   155	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
   156	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
   157	#                              are not frontmatter)
   158	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
   159	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
   160	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
   161	#                              "no mount"
   162	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
   163	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
   164	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
   165	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
   166	#
   167	# Usage:
   168	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
   169	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
   170	#
   171	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
   172	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
   173	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
   174	#
   175	# Exit codes:
   176	#   0  every rule OK
   177	#   1  any rule FAIL
   178	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
   179	#
   180	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
   181	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
   182	# =============================================================================
   183	set -euo pipefail
   184	export LC_ALL=C
   185	
   186	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
   187	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
   188	
   189	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
   190	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
   191	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   192	  case "$1" in
   193	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   194	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   195	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   196	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   197	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
   198	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
   199	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
   200	  esac
   201	done
   202	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
   203	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
   204	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
   205	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
   206	
   207	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
   208	EVID=""
   209	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
   210	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
   211	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
   212	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
   213	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
   214	}
   215	
   216	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
   217	  local type kind
   218	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   219	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
   220	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
   221	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
   222	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
   223	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   224	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   225	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   226	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   227	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   228	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   229	    | .out | join(",")'
   230	}
   231	
   232	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   233	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   234	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   235	}
   236	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   237	  local f n=0 hit=""
   238	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   239	    n=$((n + 1))
   240	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   241	  done < <(argv_files)
   242	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   243	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   244	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   245	}
   246	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   247	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   248	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
   249	}
   250	rule_all_phases_present() {
   251	  local want got st
   252	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   253	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   254	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   255	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   256	  case "$st" in
   257	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   258	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   259	  esac
   260	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
   261	}
   262	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   263	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   264	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
   265	  EVID="no PLAN record"
   266	}
   267	rule_one_voice_planned() {
   268	  local g f v bad="" ev=""
   269	  for g in review audit; do
   270	    f="$(envelope "$g")"
   271	    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
   272	    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
   273	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   274	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
   275	    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
   276	  done
   277	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
   278	  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
   279	}
   280	rule_no_gate_phases() {
   281	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   282	  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
   283	  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
   284	}
   285	rule_enforce_env_false() {
   286	  local f n=0 bad=""
   287	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   288	    n=$((n + 1))
   289	    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
   290	  done < <(argv_files)
   291	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   292	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
   293	  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
   294	}
   295	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
   296	  local n=0
   297	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   298	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   299	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   300	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
   301	  fi
   302	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
   303	  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
   304	  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
   305	}
   306	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   307	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   308	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   309	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
   310	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
   311	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   312	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   313	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
   314	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   315	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   316	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   317	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   318	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
   319	  done < <(argv_files)
   320	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
   321	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
   322	}
   323	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   324	  local r a impl
   325	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"

   335	rule_effort_flag_medium() {

   357	rule_integrity_clean() {
   358	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out

   366	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   367	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   368	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   369	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   370	def sha(p):
   371	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   372	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   373	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   374	            h.update(b)

   387	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   388	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi

   393	rule_applicability_refused() {
   394	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   395	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   396	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   397	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   398	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch

   408	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   409	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   410	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   411	  fi
   412	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   413	}
   414	
   415	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   416	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   417	  R="$1"
   418	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   419	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   420	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   421	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   422	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   423	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   424	  ARM="$arm"
   425	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   426	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   427	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   428	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   429	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   430	    return 0
   431	  fi
   432	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   433	    rules="applicability_refused"
   434	  else
   435	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   436	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   437	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   438	  fi
   439	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   440	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   441	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   442	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   443	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   444	    else
   445	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   446	    fi
   447	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   448	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   449	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   450	    else
   451	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   452	    fi
   453	  done <<<"$rules"
   454	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   455	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   456	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   457	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   458	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   459	  else
   460	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   461	  fi
   462	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   463	}
   464	
   465	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   466	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   467	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   468	  exit "$rc"
   469	fi
   470	
   471	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
   472	runs=0 failed=0
   473	while IFS= read -r d; do
   474	  runs=$((runs + 1))
   475	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
   476	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   477	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   478	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
   479	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
   480	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
   481	[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
   482	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
   483	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    35	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    36	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    37	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    38	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    39	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    40	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    41	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    42	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    43	#
    44	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    45	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    46	# =============================================================================
    47	set -euo pipefail
    48	export LC_ALL=C
    49	
    50	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    51	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    52	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    53	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    54	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    55	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
    56	
    57	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    58	die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    59	
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    63	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
    64	    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
    65	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    67	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    68	  esac
    69	done
    70	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    71	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    72	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    73	for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    74	# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
    75	pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
    76	# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    77	source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    78	popd >/dev/null
    79	
    80	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
    81	trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
    82	yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
    83	
    84	# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).
    85	: > "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    86	for group in tasks smoke; do
    87	  [[ "$group" == "smoke" && "$SMOKE" != "true" ]] && continue
    88	  [[ -d "$ROOT/$group" ]] || continue
    89	  for d in "$ROOT/$group"/*/; do
    90	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    91	    d="${d%/}"
    92	    n="$(basename "$d")"
    93	    j="$WORK/$group.$n.json"
    94	    if [[ ! -f "$d/task.yaml" ]]; then
    95	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "-" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"; continue
    96	    fi
    97	    if yq -o=json '.' "$d/task.yaml" > "$j" 2>/dev/null && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$j" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    98	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "$j" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    99	    else
   100	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   101	    fi
   102	  done
   103	done
   104	
   105	# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;
   106	# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.
   107	python3 -I - "$WORK/tasks.tsv" "$WORK/suite.json" "$ROOT" "$REPO_ROOT" "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" "$PROMPTS_DIR" > "$WORK/out.txt" <<'PY' || { cat "$WORK/out.txt" >&2 2>/dev/null; die "validator crashed"; }
   108	import json, os, re, sys
   109	
   110	tasks_tsv, suite_json, root, repo, allow_partial, prompts_dir = sys.argv[1:7]
   111	allow_partial = allow_partial == "true"
   112	suite = json.load(open(suite_json))
   113	out = []
   114	def bad(tid, msg): out.append(f"{tid}: {msg}")
   115	
   116	TYPES = ["feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor", "review-catch"]
   117	BUILD = {"feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   118	ALLOW = {"python3", "pytest", "bats", "bash", "node", "npx"}
   119	KNOWN_TASK_TYPES = {"all", "build", "review-catch", "feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   120	MOUNT_OWNED = (".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run")
   121	REQUIRED = ["id", "schema_version", "type", "source", "post_cutoff", "fixture", "criterion",
   122	            "success_criterion", "test_command", "regression_command", "reference_patch",
   123	            "grader_protected", "structural_check", "bounds", "review_catch", "suite_version"]
   124	
   125	arms = [a for a in (suite.get("arms") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
   126	arm_ids = sorted({a.get("id") for a in arms if isinstance(a.get("id"), str)})
   127	for a in arms:
   128	    if a.get("absent") is True:
   129	        continue
   130	    tt = a.get("task_types")
   131	    if not isinstance(tt, list) or not tt:
   132	        bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} has no task_types list")
   133	        continue
   134	    for t in tt:
   135	        if t not in KNOWN_TASK_TYPES:
   136	            bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} task_types names unknown type '{t}'")
   137	suite_version = suite.get("suite_version")
   138	
   139	def rel_ok(p):
   140	    return isinstance(p, str) and p and not p.startswith("/") and ".." not in p.split("/") and "\\" not in p
   141	
   142	def is_str_list(v):
   143	    return isinstance(v, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in v)
   144	
   145	def read(p):
   146	    try:
   147	        return open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
   148	    except OSError:
   149	        return None
   150	
   151	prompt_texts = []
   152	if os.path.isdir(prompts_dir):
   153	    for f in sorted(os.listdir(prompts_dir)):
   154	        if f.endswith(".md"):
   155	            prompt_texts.append((f"phase-prompts/{f}", read(os.path.join(prompts_dir, f)) or ""))
   156	
   157	def leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids):
   158	    low = text.lower()
   159	    if "hidden" in low:
   160	        bad(tid, f"leak: {label} contains the string 'hidden'")
   161	    for s in stems:
   162	        if s and re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(s.lower()) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])", low):
   163	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names the grader file stem '{s}'")
   164	    for d in defect_ids:
   165	        if d in text:
   166	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names defect id '{d}'")
   167	    m = re.search(r"\bD[0-9]{2}-", text)
   168	    if m:
   169	        bad(tid, f"leak: {label} carries a defect key pattern '{m.group(0)}'")
   170	    for a in arm_ids:
   171	        if re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(a) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])", text):
   172	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names arm id '{a}'")
   173	
   174	counts = {t: 0 for t in TYPES}
   175	seen = {}
   176	for line in open(tasks_tsv, encoding="utf-8"):
   177	    line = line.rstrip("\n")
   178	    if not line:
   179	        continue
   180	    group, name, tdir, jpath = line.split("\t")
   181	    tid = f"{group}/{name}"
   182	    if jpath == "-":
   183	        bad(tid, "no task.yaml"); continue
   184	    if jpath == "!":
   185	        bad(tid, "task.yaml is not a YAML mapping"); continue
   186	    t = json.load(open(jpath))
   187	    for k in REQUIRED:
   188	        if k not in t:
   189	            bad(tid, f"schema: missing field '{k}'")
   190	    if t.get("id") != name:
   191	        bad(tid, f"schema: id '{t.get('id')}' differs from the directory name")
   192	    if not isinstance(t.get("id"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}", t.get("id") or ""):
   193	        bad(tid, "schema: id must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}")
   194	    elif t["id"] in seen:
   195	        bad(tid, f"schema: duplicate id (also {seen[t['id']]})")
   196	    else:
   197	        seen[t["id"]] = tid
   198	    if t.get("schema_version") != 1:
   199	        bad(tid, "schema: schema_version must be 1")
   200	    ttype = t.get("type")
   201	    if ttype not in TYPES:
   202	        bad(tid, f"schema: type '{ttype}' not in {'|'.join(TYPES)}")
